name: mirage
text: Understood and already in place: three scheduled Claude rotation runs a day (analyst, engineer, watch) study scans, fills, bids, volume and bet types, then change settings and filters on their own, with every change logged in research/review/CHANGES.md and a revert rule. I won't ask you first. Today I lowered the bid margin (slider 68 to 80) and added the thin-books guard.
